newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close down at 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close down at 21 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates ended easier on Friday in a liquid market as banks sat on abundant funds ahead of the end of the current two-week reserve period on Saturday, dealers said.
The market opened slightly higher than Thursday's closing level at 21.5 to 21.75 percent, but with no takers rates soon fell, dealers added.
"Banks have plenty of liquidity at the end of the reserve period," said Eniko Lederer of Citibank. "It was very quiet."
